import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { activeTotal } from './payments-under-test.mjs';

assert.equal(activeTotal([]), 0);
const rows = [
  { amount: 105, voidedAt: null },
  { amount: -21, voidedAt: null },
  { amount: 40, voidedAt: '2026-01-01' },
];
const original = structuredClone(rows);
assert.equal(activeTotal(rows), 84);
assert.deepEqual(rows, original);
assert.throws(() => activeTotal([{ amount: 0.5, voidedAt: null }]), RangeError);
assert.throws(() => activeTotal([{ amount: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, voidedAt: null }, { amount: 1, voidedAt: null }]), RangeError);
assert.equal(activeTotal([{ amount: NaN, voidedAt: 'voided' }]), 0);
